page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.18xlarge is a general-purpose cloud instance built on KVM virtualization and the x86_64 architecture. Powered by Intel Xeon 8163 processors operating at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz, this instance features 72 dedicated vCPUs and 288.0 GB of system memory. This provides a balanced memory-to-vCPU allocation ratio of 4.0 GB per core, suitable for multi-threaded enterprise application workloads requiring large parallel computing capability.

The instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 33 Gbps to support data-intensive network traffic. It does not include local disk storage, requiring external network-attached block storage for persistent or ephemeral data. Additionally, the instance is deployed without discrete GPU hardware accelerators or complimentary public IPv4 addresses, focusing resource allocation entirely on compute threads, system memory, and network throughput.

With 72 dedicated vCPUs and 288 GB of memory, the ecs.g5ne.18xlarge instance provides high resource density for enterprise operations. The absence of integrated local storage separates compute provisioning from storage overhead, allowing independent scaling of block storage volumes. This instance type is suitable for enterprise web serving, distributed microservices architectures, application servers, middleware clusters, and continuous integration build environments.
